profiles.title: Frontend UI
profiles.description: Design or improve frontend user interfaces with visual, accessibility, and browser verification.

profiles.title: Bug Diagnosis
profiles.description: Debug bugs, failures, flakes, slowness, or regressions with reproduce-minimise-hypothesise-instrument-fix loop.
notes: Use diagnose for root cause analysis.
Add tdd for narrow regression tests.

profiles.title: Security Review
profiles.description: Review security risks for auth, user input, API endpoints, secrets, uploads, and sensitive data handling.
notes: Security review is read-only — do not modify or execute.
Always review auth, authorization, and user input boundaries.

profiles.title: Release Check
profiles.description: Pre-merge or pre-deploy readiness check covering git state, build/test, migrations, env risk, and smoke routes.
notes: Check git state, build, tests, and migrations.
